class.name: IfcMechanicalFastener
class.brief_description: Definition from IAI: Fasteners connecting building elements mechanically. A single instance of this class may represent one or many of actual mechanical fasteners, for example an array of bolts or a row of nails. HISTORY New entity in IFC Release 2x2 IFC 2x4 change: Supertype changed from IfcFastener to IfcElementComponent . Attribute PredefinedType added. Attributes NominalDiameter and NominalLen

members.member: A float, or null when unset.
A float, or null when unset.
Subtype of mechanical fastener A String, one of the enumeration's values, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
